rationale: The agent successfully authenticated the user by matching the full name and zip code to the account. The agent then identified the correct order containing the boots and confirmed the user's requested changes: modifying the size of the hiking boots from 10 to 8 and keeping the material the same. The agent correctly stated the change and obtained explicit consent from the user before proceeding with the modification. The final details provided to the user after the successful change were accurate, meeting all policy requirements.
